00000000010100000000010000010011   # addi s0, zero, 5
00000000110001011000011000110011   # add  a2, a1, a2
00000000011001001010010000100011   # sw   t1, 8(s1)
11111110011000101000110011100011   # beq  t0, t1, -8
00000000000000010000001010110111   # lui  t0, 0x10
00000000000000000000000011101111   # jal  ra, 0
00000000000000000000000000010011   # addi x0, x0, 0 -> nop
00000000000000001000000001100111   # jalr x0, 0(x1) -> ret
